{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any of them are in the NEW + PAID_SEARCH group
qa_in_new_paid_search = qa_orders[(qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (qa_orders['channel'] == 'paid_search')]
print(f"QA orders in NEW + PAID_SEARCH group: {len(qa_in_new_paid_search)}")

# Now filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
new_paid_search = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Check for refunded orders in this group
refunded_in_group = new_paid_search[new_paid_search['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders in NEW + PAID_SEARCH group: {len(refunded_in_group)}")

# Compute conversion rate
converted_count = new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(new_paid_search)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted count: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total count: {total_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the fraction
conversion_rate"}
